objective: Auditar el estado AS-IS canónico del dominio Services/Prestadores de Servicios en EDARSAHUB, identificando capacidades existentes, bounded contexts, tablas SQL, endpoints, frontend, workflows, autorizaciones, RBAC, integraciones y dependencias. No crear tablas, endpoints, frontend, migraciones ni refactors; no tocar RBAC, menús, Scheduler, Universal Worker, NetPay ni Production; no crecer Core ni duplicar capacidades existentes.

queries.name: services_schema_inventory
queries.sql: SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_TYPE = 'BASE TABLE' AND (LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%servic%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%prestador%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%proveedor%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%contrat%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%orden%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%workflow%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%autoriz%') ORDER BY TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME

queries.name: services_column_inventory
queries.sql: SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%servic%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%prestador%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%proveedor%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%contrat%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%orden%' OR LOWER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE '%workflow%' ORDER BY TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION
